items.quote: Direct reports said that Zeel led teamwork across departments on the annual review across the department.
Zeel was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes.
Direct reports said that Zeel championed the transformation of the operating model and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Several respondents noted that Zeel drove public communications on the new scheme for the whole division.
Direct reports said that Zeel Quenira spearheaded drafting legislative amendments for the new act at the national level.
Direct reports said that Zeel spearheaded community engagement on the estate renewal plan at the national level.
Several respondents noted that Zeel Quenira set the direction for a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading across the public service.
Direct reports said that Zeel led coaching and mentoring junior officers across the department.
